title: Asymmetric Monitoring: Does Reducing Monitor Coverage Disproportionately Increase Risk?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: If risk is super-linear in coverage reduction, operators need to know that halving monitoring more than halves safety. This is an immediately deployable finding for any organization running agentic AI systems.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Building a simulated agentic pipeline with configurable monitoring requires moderate engineering. The simulation design and statistical analysis of risk-vs-coverage curves adds complexity. Feasible with medium compute.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Single simulation experiment varying one parameter (coverage %) and measuring one output (harm rate). Clear deliverable (risk-vs-coverage curve). Feasible in 30 hours if the simulation is kept simple, but building the pipeline takes time.
